title: Country Christmas Coloring Book
sellingPoints: 66 country Christmas scenes: snowy barns, farmhouse wreaths, vintage trucks hauling trees
Bold, open line art a beginner can finish, with depth for experienced colorists
23 printable covers to bind your own book or wrap it as a gift
US Letter 8.5 x 11 in, prints edge to edge at 100%
Print-ready PDF plus 300 dpi PNG and JPG files
notes: Seasonal: strongest from November until Christmas — use 'gift' angles (print, bind with one of the 23 covers, wrap). Written for adults (cover says 'for Adults'), but the listing also pitches it as one book for the whole family table, so family wording is fine. 'Hit print. It fits.' applies (8.5 x 11 in). Listing mentions therapy groups — never use that. mockups/3.jpg (line art vs colored truck) makes a great carousel cover or reel ending; mockups/2.jpg is a cozy flat lay; mockups/1.jpg is the cover.
